question: How many WebSocket messages does a phone mounted in a chat decode while one agent turn runs ten sequential tool calls? Each message is a radio/CPU wakeup and a decode on the phone.
why_objective: Faux model, fixed workload, fresh fixture Gateway; integer counts repeat exactly except documented one-frame timing jitter, which compare never treats as a verdict.
ungated_reason: Host-load and window-length sensitive; reported, never decisive. Every other metric of every measured scenario must not regress beyond the shared noise bound.
correctness: cd packages/gateway && t=$(mktemp -d) && HOME=$t TMPDIR=$t NPM_CONFIG_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=false npx vitest run src/admin/settings-gate.e2e.test.ts; s=$?; rm -rf "$t"; exit $s
protected_behavior: Wire protocol shape and every event the iOS app decodes (protocol-fixtures are frozen).
Streaming cadence (STREAMING_PROGRESS_FLUSH_MS) and every UX-visible timing; fewer frames bought by slower or coarser UI updates is not an improvement.
